manifest.name: bookmarks
manifest.description: Mark lines to come back to: a gutter, next and previous bookmark across files, a Bookmarks view and Go to Bookmark. They move with edits and are saved with the project.

manifest.name: code-image
manifest.description: Copy the selected code (or the file) as a polished picture, in your theme and font.

lineNumbers.title: Line Numbers in Images
lineNumbers.description: Number the lines in pictures made with Copy as Image.

manifest.name: color-preview
manifest.description: Inline swatches for hex, rgb() and hsl() colors. Click a hex swatch to pick a new color.

languages.title: Show In
languages.description: Every file, or only CSS / SCSS / Less / HTML.

manifest.name: command-palette
manifest.description: Find and run any command by name.

manifest.name: editor-guides
manifest.description: Indent guides that follow scope.

highlightActiveScope.title: Highlight Active Scope
highlightActiveScope.description: Brighten the guide of the block the cursor is in.

manifest.name: emmet
manifest.description: Type an abbreviation like ul>li.item*3 in HTML, JSX or CSS and press Tab to expand it.

enabled.title: Emmet Abbreviations
enabled.description: Press Tab after an abbreviation (div#app, ul>li*3, m10) in HTML, JSX, Vue and CSS files to expand it.

manifest.name: find-in-project
manifest.description: Search and replace across every file in the project.

manifest.name: focus-mode
manifest.description: Typewriter scrolling keeps your cursor centered; other paragraphs fade back.

typewriter.title: Typewriter Scrolling
typewriter.description: Keep the cursor line vertically centered.

manifest.name: fonts
manifest.description: 27 bundled open-source fonts for code and UI, with live previews. JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Cascadia Code, Geist, Iosevka, Monaspace, Inter and more.

manifest.name: fuzzy-finder
manifest.description: Open project files, open tabs and recent files by fuzzy name.

manifest.name: image-viewer
manifest.description: Open PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, SVG, ICO, BMP and AVIF files in a tab with zoom.

manifest.name: markdown-preview
manifest.description: Live preview of Markdown files in a split pane.

remoteImages.title: Load Remote Images
remoteImages.description: Show https:// images in previews. Off by default, because loading them tells the image server when you opened the file.

syncScroll.title: Sync Scrolling
syncScroll.description: Scrolling the editor scrolls the preview to the same place, and the other way round. Clicking the preview moves the editor's cursor there.

manifest.name: merge-conflicts
manifest.description: Resolve merge conflicts in the editor: tinted sections, Accept Current / Incoming / Both and Compare above each block, and F7 to jump between them.

manifest.name: minimap
manifest.description: A zoomed-out overview of the file along the right edge. Click or drag to scroll.

display.title: Display
display.description: Draw real characters or simplified blocks.

manifest.name: outline
manifest.description: Breadcrumbs above the editor and an Outline view of the file's symbols, from its language server or, without one, from the syntax (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Markdown, CSS, JSON).

breadcrumbs.title: Breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.description: Show the file's folder, name and the symbols around the cursor above each editor.

followCursor.title: Outline Follows the Cursor
followCursor.description: Highlight the symbol at the cursor in the Outline view and scroll to it.

manifest.name: settings-view
manifest.description: A friendly UI for settings, themes, packages and keybindings.

manifest.name: snippets
manifest.description: Type a prefix and press Tab. Built-in snippets for popular languages, plus your own (VS Code format).

tabExpands.title: Tab Expands Prefixes
tabExpands.description: Pressing Tab right after a snippet prefix expands it.

manifest.name: status-bar
manifest.description: Cursor position, language, indentation and more.

manifest.name: sticky-scroll
manifest.description: Pins the headers of the functions, classes and blocks you're scrolled into to the top of the editor.

manifest.name: abyss
manifest.description: Deep-sea navy with bioluminescent cyan.

manifest.name: blossom
manifest.description: Cherry-blossom pinks on a soft blush background.

manifest.name: cocoa
manifest.description: Creamy pastels on a deep mocha base, in the spirit of Catppuccin.

manifest.name: contrast
manifest.description: Maximum legibility: pure black, bright text and bold borders.

manifest.name: daylight
manifest.description: A crisp, warm light theme.

manifest.name: dune
manifest.description: Warm sand and ink. A soft, low-glare light theme for long sessions.

manifest.name: ember
manifest.description: Warm charcoal with glowing orange. Like coding by a fire.

manifest.name: fjord
manifest.description: Cool arctic blues, inspired by Nord.

manifest.name: glacier
manifest.description: Cool, airy light theme with ice-blue and teal.

manifest.name: grove
manifest.description: Deep forest greens and soft earth tones.

manifest.name: harvest
manifest.description: Retro, earthy and high-contrast, in the spirit of Gruvbox.

manifest.name: metro
manifest.description: City lights at night: indigo, neon blue and violet, in the spirit of Tokyo Night.

manifest.name: midnight
manifest.description: True black with neon accents. Gorgeous on OLED and in dark rooms.

manifest.name: nightfall
manifest.description: A calm, deep dark theme. The default.

manifest.name: nocturne
manifest.description: Vivid pastels on violet-gray, in the spirit of Dracula.

manifest.name: paper
manifest.description: Ink on paper. Quiet, nearly monochrome syntax for focused writing.

manifest.name: rosewood
manifest.description: Dusky purples and rose. Soft on the eyes at night.

manifest.name: solstice
manifest.description: Precise, sunlit tones, in the spirit of Solarized Light.

manifest.name: volcano
manifest.description: Hot pink, lime and lava on olive black, in the spirit of Monokai.

manifest.name: todos
manifest.description: Highlights TODO, FIXME and friends in comments, and lists every one in the project.

manifest.name: tree-view
manifest.description: Browse and manage project files in the sidebar.

autoReveal.title: Auto Reveal
autoReveal.description: Select the active file in the tree as you switch tabs.

singleClickPreview.title: Preview on Single Click
singleClickPreview.description: Single click opens a preview tab that is replaced by the next preview.

manifest.name: vim-mode
manifest.description: Vim keybindings: modes, motions, operators, registers, macros, :w / :q and more.

insertModeEscape.title: Insert Mode Escape
insertModeEscape.description: Leave insert mode by typing this sequence, e.g. "jj" or "jk". Empty to disable.

useSystemClipboard.title: Use System Clipboard
useSystemClipboard.description: Make y/p use the system clipboard (the unnamed register).
